entities.summary: Lydia Grigorieva is a Ukrainian poet who now lives in London. Her work has been widely translated and she has worked with the BBC World Service, Russian radio and television and the British Library. Lydia Grigorieva was a painters & sculptors from Novosvitlivka (b. 1945-08-12, Novosvitlivka). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
